name: Progesterone (micronized)
summary: Micronized bioidentical progesterone in oil capsules; oral intake converts heavily into sedative GABA-A neurosteroids (allopregnanolone), while rectal administration yields higher unmetabolized serum P4.
advisory: Oral administration induces drowsiness via neurosteroid metabolites; administer immediately before sleep.

combinations.note: Oral allopregnanolone metabolites add to GABA-A sedation.

pharmacology.text: Progesterone is the most important progestogen in the body. As a potent agonist of the nuclear progesterone receptor (nPR) (with an affinity of KD = 1 nM), the resulting effects on ribosomal transcription play a major role in regulation of female reproduction.

uses.text: Progesterone is used as a medication. The hormone is used in combination with estrogens mainly in hormone therapy for menopausal symptoms and low sex hormone levels. It may also be used alone to treat menopausal symptoms.
uses.routes: By mouth, topical/transdermal, vaginal, intramuscular injection, subcutaneous injection, subcutaneous implant

summaryZh: 孕酮（英語：progesterone，縮寫：P4），化學命名：孕甾-4-烯-3,20-二酮，是一種內源性類固醇和孕激素（progestogen，性激素的一種），參與人類和其他物種的月經週期、妊娠和胚胎發生，是體內主要的孕激素，大部分是由女性卵巢黃體的黃體細胞分泌。
